18.t: Working with data: carbon dioxide and temperature
q: Calculate the rise in CO₂ from 1960 to 2020.
Describe the relationship between CO₂ and temperature.
As CO₂ rises, the temperature rises too: a positive correlation.
Explain how extra CO₂ can warm the Earth, and why correlation alone does not prove it.
CO₂ absorbs infrared from the Earth and re-emits some back: the greenhouse effect. Proof comes from the physics of CO₂ and many studies, not the correlation alone.
